dishes.name: Macaroni and cheese
dishes.veganApproach: Make the sauce from a roux with vegan butter and plant milk plus plant-based cheddar, or blend a potato, carrot or cashew sauce with nutritional yeast.
dishes.technique: A roux-based cheddar sauce is stirred through al dente elbow macaroni, then baked under a buttered crumb topping until bubbling.

sources.title: Crispy Baked Vegan Mac and Cheese - Rainbow Plant Life
20-Minute Vegan Mac and Cheese - Minimalist Baker

dishes.name: Chili con carne
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the beef with extra beans, lentils or soy mince; the spiced tomato base stays the same.
dishes.technique: Onion, garlic and dried chili spices are bloomed in oil, then meat or beans and tomatoes simmer slowly into a thick, spicy stew.

dishes.name: Cincinnati chili
dishes.veganApproach: Simmer lentils or plant-based mince in the warmly spiced tomato sauce and finish with plant-based cheddar.
dishes.technique: A thin, warmly spiced meat sauce with cinnamon, allspice and cocoa is ladled over spaghetti and stacked with cheddar, onions or beans as 'ways'.

dishes.name: Chicken pot pie
dishes.veganApproach: Fill with vegetables plus chickpeas or white beans in a plant-milk gravy and top with a dairy-free crust or vegan puff pastry.
dishes.technique: A creamy roux-thickened filling of chicken and vegetables is sealed under pastry and baked until golden.

dishes.name: Sloppy joe
dishes.veganApproach: Use cooked lentils or soy mince in the sweet and tangy tomato sauce, with a vegan Worcestershire sauce.
dishes.technique: Ground meat is browned with onion and pepper, simmered in a sweet, tangy tomato sauce and spooned onto soft buns.

sources.title: Lentil Sloppy Joes - A Couple Cooks

dishes.name: Veggie burger
dishes.veganApproach: Bind the patties with flax, aquafaba or starch instead of egg and top with vegan cheese and mayo.
dishes.technique: Mashed beans, grains and browned vegetables are bound into patties, seared until crusty and served in a bun with classic burger toppings.

sources.title: The Best Black Bean Burger - Serious Eats
Homemade Veggie Burgers That Don't Suck - Serious Eats

dishes.name: Meatloaf
dishes.veganApproach: Shape a loaf from lentils, oats, walnuts and sautéed vegetables bound with flax, then glaze it with ketchup as usual.
dishes.technique: Seasoned ground meat bound with egg and breadcrumbs is shaped into a loaf, glazed with ketchup, baked and served in thick slices.

dishes.name: Tuna noodle casserole
dishes.veganApproach: Swap the tuna for mashed chickpeas seasoned with nori and Old Bay, folded into a plant-milk mushroom sauce with egg-free pasta.
dishes.technique: Noodles, flaked tuna and peas are folded into a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with crumbs or crushed crackers and baked until bubbling.

sources.title: Vegan Chickpea Tuna Casserole - The Viet Vegan

dishes.name: Tater tot hotdish
dishes.veganApproach: Use plant-based ground or seitan with a homemade mushroom sauce thickened with flour and plant milk.
dishes.technique: Browned meat and vegetables bound in creamy mushroom soup are covered with rows of frozen tater tots and baked until crisp.

sources.title: Vegan Tater Tot Hotdish - MN Veg Head

dishes.name: American goulash
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the beef with lentils, mushrooms or TVP; the one-pot tomato and macaroni base is otherwise unchanged.
dishes.technique: Ground beef, onion and tomatoes simmer in one pot with paprika, and the uncooked macaroni cooks directly in the sauce.

sources.title: Vegan Goulash (American Version) - Keeping the Peas

dishes.name: New England clam chowder
dishes.veganApproach: Use oyster or king oyster mushrooms with seaweed for briny depth, smoked paprika in place of the pork and a cashew or plant-milk base.
dishes.technique: Rendered salt pork and onion form the base, potatoes simmer in clam broth, and chopped clams and cream go in at the end.

sources.title: Vegan New England Clam Chowder - Catskill Animal Sanctuary

dishes.name: Corn chowder
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the bacon, add smoked paprika, and make it creamy with coconut milk, cashews or part of the soup blended.
dishes.technique: Corn and diced potatoes simmer in stock and milk, then part of the soup is blended for a thick but chunky chowder.

sources.title: Creamy Vegan Corn Chowder - A Couple Cooks

dishes.name: Grilled cheese sandwich
dishes.veganApproach: Use a plant-based cheese that melts well and vegan butter; the classic tomato soup on the side is easily vegan too.
dishes.technique: Buttered bread is griddled slowly in a pan so the outside crisps while the cheese inside melts.

dishes.name: BLT
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the bacon with smoky marinated tempeh or tofu strips and use vegan mayonnaise.
dishes.technique: Crisp-fried bacon is layered with ripe tomato and lettuce on toasted bread spread with mayonnaise.

dishes.name: Philly cheesesteak
dishes.veganApproach: Sear thinly sliced seitan or portobello mushrooms hard with onions and peppers, then top with a plant-based cheese sauce.
dishes.technique: Paper-thin steak is chopped on a hot griddle with onions, covered with melting cheese and scooped into a long roll.

sources.title: Portobello Seitan Vegan Philly Cheesesteak - The Vegan Atlas
Vegan Philly Cheesesteak - At Elizabeth's Table

dishes.name: Reuben sandwich
dishes.veganApproach: Marinated, pan-seared tempeh replaces the corned beef, with plant-based Swiss and a vegan Russian dressing.
dishes.technique: Corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut and Russian dressing are stacked on rye and griddled in butter until the cheese melts.

sources.title: Vegan Tempeh Reuben - My Darling Vegan

dishes.name: Lobster roll
dishes.veganApproach: Hearts of palm, sautéed in vegan butter and dressed with vegan mayo, Old Bay, dill and lemon, stand in for the lobster.
dishes.technique: Cooked lobster meat is dressed cold with mayonnaise (Maine style) or warmed in butter (Connecticut style) and piled into a toasted, buttered bun.

sources.title: Easy Vegan Lobster Rolls - Live Eat Learn
Easy Vegan Lobster Rolls With Hearts of Palm - VegNews

dishes.name: Crab cakes
dishes.veganApproach: Flaked hearts of palm or chickpeas seasoned with Old Bay and seaweed are bound with vegan mayo and breadcrumbs, then pan-fried.
dishes.technique: Lump crab is bound with as little filler as possible, chilled to firm up and pan-fried or broiled until golden.

sources.title: Vegan Crab Cakes - Loving It Vegan

dishes.name: Cobb salad
dishes.veganApproach: Swap the chicken, bacon and eggs for smoky tempeh 'bacon' and chickpeas, and use a vegan cheese or simply more avocado.
dishes.technique: Chopped greens are topped with neat rows of chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese, then dressed with a red wine vinaigrette.

sources.title: Vegan Cobb Salad with Tempeh Bacon - Simply Quinoa

dishes.name: Baked potato
dishes.veganApproach: Top with vegan butter, cashew sour cream, chili or beans and plant-based cheese.
dishes.technique: Large floury potatoes are baked slowly until the skin is crisp and the flesh fluffy, then split open and loaded with toppings.

dishes.name: Split pea soup
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the ham hock and add smoked paprika or a few drops of liquid smoke for the smoky depth.
dishes.technique: Dried split peas simmer slowly with a ham bone and aromatics until they collapse into a thick, smoky purée.

sources.title: Smoky Vegan Split Pea Soup - Vegan with Gusto
Smoky Vegetarian Split Pea Soup - Connoisseurus Veg

dishes.name: Chicken noodle soup
dishes.veganApproach: Chickpeas replace the chicken, and nutritional yeast with thyme and sautéed aromatics gives the vegetable broth its savory depth.
dishes.technique: Chicken simmers with root vegetables into a clear broth, then the meat is shredded back in with egg noodles.

sources.title: Vegan Chickpea Noodle Soup - America's Test Kitchen

dishes.name: Gumbo
dishes.veganApproach: Make the dark roux with oil and use okra, mushrooms, beans or vegan andouille; gumbo z'herbes is a traditional meatless greens version.
dishes.technique: Flour and fat are stirred patiently into a dark roux, then the onion, celery and pepper 'holy trinity', stock, okra and proteins simmer into a thick stew served over rice.

sources.title: Vegan Gumbo (Louisiana Style) - Dances with Knives

dishes.name: Jambalaya
dishes.veganApproach: Use kidney beans, mushrooms or vegan sausage with smoked paprika and Creole spices in place of the meats.
dishes.technique: Rice cooks in the same pot as browned sausage, the holy trinity, tomatoes (Creole style) and stock until it absorbs all the seasoned liquid.

dishes.name: Red beans and rice
dishes.veganApproach: Skip the ham hock and sausage; smoked paprika, liquid smoke or vegan sausage bring the smokiness, and mashing some beans makes it creamy.
dishes.technique: Dried red beans simmer for hours with the holy trinity and smoked pork until creamy, traditionally on Mondays, and are served over white rice.

sources.title: New Orleans-Style Vegan Red Beans & Rice - Camellia Brand
Vegan Slow-Cooker Red Beans and Rice - NYT Cooking

dishes.name: Crawfish étouffée
dishes.veganApproach: Oyster mushrooms replace the crawfish in an oil-based blond roux seasoned with Creole spice, Old Bay and a little dulse for a sea-like note.
dishes.technique: A blond roux and the holy trinity form a thick, rich sauce in which crawfish tails are briefly 'smothered', then spooned over rice.

dishes.name: Shrimp and grits
dishes.technique: Stone-ground grits are simmered slowly until creamy and enriched with butter and cheese, then topped with shrimp quickly sautéed with mushrooms, garlic and lemon.

sources.title: Lowcountry Shrimp and Grits - Southern Living

dishes.name: Po' boy
dishes.veganApproach: Battered and fried oyster mushrooms or cornmeal-crusted tofu replace the seafood, dressed with a vegan rémoulade.
dishes.technique: Seafood is dredged in seasoned cornmeal, fried crisp and piled into airy New Orleans French bread 'dressed' with lettuce, tomato, pickles and rémoulade.

sources.title: Vegan Oyster Mushroom Po' Boy - Hot for Food
Vegan Po' Boy with Cornmeal Crusted Tofu - Connoisseurus Veg

dishes.name: Hoppin' John
dishes.veganApproach: Cook the peas with onion, smoked paprika and a touch of liquid smoke instead of the ham hock and bacon.
dishes.technique: Black-eyed peas simmer with smoked pork and aromatics, then rice cooks in the pot liquor; traditionally eaten on New Year's Day with greens.

sources.title: Vegan Hoppin' John - Holy Cow Vegan

dishes.name: Southern fried chicken
dishes.veganApproach: Seitan, pressed tofu or oyster mushrooms are soaked in a spiced plant-milk 'buttermilk', dredged in seasoned flour and fried.
dishes.technique: Chicken pieces soaked in seasoned buttermilk are dredged in spiced flour and fried in hot oil until shatteringly crisp.

sources.title: The Best Southern Vegan Fried Chicken - Veganosity
Vegan Fried Chicken - Broke Bank Vegan

dishes.name: Chicken and dumplings
dishes.veganApproach: Use chickpeas or seitan in a creamy vegetable broth, and make the dumplings with plant milk and vegan butter.
dishes.technique: Chicken simmers in a thickened broth, then soft biscuit-style or rolled dumplings are dropped in and steamed under a lid.

sources.title: Vegan Chicken and Dumplings - Nora Cooks
Vegan Chicken and Dumplings - Live Eat Learn

dishes.name: Brunswick stew
dishes.veganApproach: Shredded young jackfruit or vegan crumbles simmer with lima beans, corn and tomatoes in a smoky, tangy barbecue-sauce base.
dishes.technique: Smoked or stewed meats simmer for hours with lima beans, corn and tomatoes until the stew is thick enough for a spoon to stand up in it.

dishes.name: Pulled pork sandwich
dishes.veganApproach: Young green jackfruit is shredded and simmered in barbecue sauce until sticky, then served with a crunchy slaw.
dishes.technique: Traditionally, pork shoulder is slow-smoked or slow-roasted until it pulls apart, tossed with tangy sauce and piled on buns with coleslaw.

sources.title: BBQ Jackfruit Sandwiches with Avocado Slaw - Minimalist Baker
BBQ Pulled Jackfruit Sandwiches - Food Network

dishes.name: Fried catfish
dishes.technique: Catfish fillets soaked in buttermilk are dredged in seasoned cornmeal and fried until golden, often served with hush puppies and coleslaw.

sources.title: Cuisine of the Southern United States - Wikipedia

dishes.name: Lowcountry boil
dishes.technique: Potatoes, sausage, corn and finally shell-on shrimp go in stages into a big pot of seasoned boiling water, then everything is drained and tipped out to share.

sources.title: Frogmore Stew (Lowcountry Boil) - South Carolina Living

dishes.name: Shepherd's pie
dishes.veganApproach: Lentils and mushrooms in a rich gravy replace the lamb, under a mash made with plant milk and vegan butter.
dishes.technique: Minced lamb is simmered in a thick gravy with vegetables, covered with mashed potato and baked until the ridged top is crisp and golden.

sources.title: Healthy Vegan Lentil Shepherd's Pie - Rainbow Plant Life
Vegan shepherd's pie - BBC Good Food

dishes.name: Fish and chips
dishes.veganApproach: Nori-wrapped tofu or banana blossom is dipped in beer batter and fried, served with chips and mushy peas.
dishes.technique: White fish fillets are dipped in cold beer batter and deep-fried, alongside thick-cut chips that are fried twice.

sources.title: Vegan Banana Blossom Fish - The Veg Space

dishes.name: Fish pie
dishes.technique: White and smoked fish are poached in milk that becomes a parsley white sauce, then the pie is topped with mash and baked.

sources.title: Classic fish pie with peas - BBC Food
Rick Stein's fish pie - BBC Food

dishes.name: Cornish pasty
dishes.veganApproach: Fill with potato, swede and onion plus lentils or mushrooms, and make the pastry with vegan butter or vegetable shortening.
dishes.technique: Raw diced beef, potato, swede and onion are sealed in a D-shaped shortcrust with a crimped edge and baked so the filling steams in its own juices.

sources.title: Vegan Cornish Pasty - Supper in the Suburbs

dishes.name: Bangers and mash
aliases: bangers and mash with onion gravy
dishes.veganApproach: Use plant-based or homemade seitan sausages, mash with plant milk and vegan butter, and make the onion gravy with vegetable stock.
dishes.technique: Sausages are fried until browned and served on creamy mashed potato with a slow-cooked onion gravy.

sources.title: Vegan Bangers, Mash and Gravy from Scratch - Exceedingly Vegan

dishes.name: Toad in the hole
dishes.nameEn: Sausages baked in Yorkshire pudding batter
dishes.veganApproach: Bake plant-based sausages in an egg-free batter made with plant milk, and serve with a red onion gravy.
dishes.technique: Sausages are roasted in very hot fat, then Yorkshire pudding batter is poured around them and baked until puffed and crisp.

sources.title: Vegan toad-in-the-hole with red onion & balsamic gravy - BBC Good Food

dishes.name: Welsh rarebit
dishes.veganApproach: Melt plant-based cheddar into a roux with ale, plant milk, mustard and a vegan Worcestershire-style sauce.
dishes.technique: A thick savoury sauce of melted cheese, ale and mustard is spread over toast and grilled until bubbling and blistered.

sources.title: Vegan Welsh Rarebit - Vegan Food & Living

dishes.name: Cauliflower cheese
dishes.veganApproach: Coat roasted cauliflower in a soya-milk béchamel seasoned with nutritional yeast and mustard, topped with vegan cheddar crumbs.
dishes.technique: Par-cooked cauliflower is smothered in a cheddar béchamel, scattered with cheese and crumbs and baked until bubbling.

sources.title: Vegan cauliflower cheese - BBC Good Food

dishes.name: Irish stew
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the lamb with mushrooms, lentils or white beans and simmer the root vegetables in vegetable stock, optionally with stout.
dishes.technique: Mutton or lamb is layered with potatoes and onions and simmered gently for hours until the potatoes break down and thicken the broth.

sources.title: Vegan Irish Stew - The Simple Veganista
Easy Vegan Irish Stew - The Fiery Vegetarian

dishes.name: Bubble and squeak
dishes.veganApproach: Fry in oil or vegan butter and skip the fried egg on top.
dishes.technique: Leftover mashed potato and cooked cabbage or sprouts are mixed, pressed into a hot pan and fried until a deep golden crust forms.

dishes.name: Kedgeree
dishes.technique: Smoked haddock is poached, its liquor used to cook basmati rice, then flaked through the curried, buttery rice with quartered boiled eggs and parsley.

sources.title: Smoked haddock kedgeree - BBC Good Food

dishes.name: Beef Wellington
dishes.veganApproach: A filling of mushrooms with chestnuts or sweet potato is wrapped in vegan puff pastry and glazed with plant milk instead of egg.
dishes.technique: Seared beef fillet is wrapped in mushroom duxelles and ham, encased in puff pastry and baked until the pastry is golden and the meat pink.

sources.title: Mushroom & sweet potato wellington - BBC Good Food

dishes.name: Steak and ale pie
dishes.veganApproach: Mixed mushrooms, sometimes with seitan, are braised in a vegan ale and stock and baked under vegan pastry.
dishes.technique: Beef is braised slowly with onions and dark ale until tender and the gravy thick, then capped with pastry and baked.

sources.title: Mushroom and ale pie - BBC Food
Ale and mushroom puff pastry pie with champ - Vegetarian Society
Vegan steak and ale pie - Vegan Recipe Club

dishes.name: Nut roast
dishes.veganApproach: Bind with flax, chickpeas or mashed vegetables instead of egg and cheese.
dishes.technique: Chopped nuts, breadcrumbs and sautéed vegetables are bound, packed into a loaf tin and baked, then sliced like a roast and served with gravy.

sources.title: Easy vegan nut roast - BBC Good Food

dishes.name: Glamorgan sausages
dishes.veganApproach: Use a crumbly plant-based cheese and bind the mixture with flax or aquafaba instead of egg.
dishes.technique: Cheese, leeks and breadcrumbs are bound with egg, rolled into sausage shapes, coated in crumbs and shallow-fried.

sources.title: How to make Glamorgan sausages - Felicity Cloake, The Guardian

dishes.name: Scouse
dishes.veganApproach: 'Blind scouse' is the traditional meatless version: a thick stew of potatoes and root vegetables, sometimes with lentils.
dishes.technique: Meat and potatoes simmer slowly until some of the potato collapses and thickens the stew, served with pickled red cabbage and crusty bread.

sources.title: Blind scouse and red cabbage - BBC Food

dishes.name: Lancashire hotpot
dishes.veganApproach: Lentils and mushrooms in a dark gravy replace the lamb under the layer of sliced potatoes, brushed with oil or vegan butter.
dishes.technique: Lamb and onions are layered in a deep pot, topped with overlapping potato slices and baked slowly, lid off at the end so the top crisps.

sources.title: Vegan hotpot with lentils and mushrooms - Lazy Cat Kitchen

dishes.name: Cullen skink
dishes.technique: Smoked haddock is poached in milk, then flaked into a soup of onions and potatoes cooked in the smoky milk.

dishes.name: Haggis, neeps and tatties
dishes.nameEn: Haggis with mashed swede and potatoes
dishes.veganApproach: Vegetarian and vegan haggis use oatmeal, lentils, beans, mushrooms and nuts with the same peppery spicing; mash the neeps and tatties with vegan butter.
dishes.technique: Minced offal, oatmeal, suet and onion are seasoned with pepper and spices, cooked in a casing and served with mashed swede and potatoes.

sources.title: Haggis, neeps & tatties - BBC Good Food

dishes.name: Leek and potato soup
dishes.veganApproach: Sweat the leeks in oil and finish with unsweetened plant milk instead of butter and cream.
dishes.technique: Leeks and potatoes are sweated gently in butter, simmered in stock and blended smooth or left slightly chunky.

sources.title: Vegan leek & potato soup - BBC Good Food
Leek & potato soup - BBC Good Food

dishes.name: Poutine
dishes.nameEn: Fries with cheese curds and gravy
dishes.veganApproach: Serve crisp fries with a mushroom or vegetable-stock gravy and plant-based mozzarella or cashew 'curds'.
dishes.technique: Twice-fried potatoes are topped with squeaky fresh cheese curds and drenched in hot gravy so the curds just begin to melt.

sources.title: History of Poutine - The Canadian Encyclopedia
Easy Vegan Poutine - Vancouver with Love

dishes.name: Tourtière
dishes.veganApproach: Lentils, mushrooms or plant-based mince replace the pork, keeping the clove and cinnamon spicing in a vegan double crust.
dishes.technique: Minced pork with onion and warm spices is cooked down, sometimes thickened with mashed potato, and baked in a double-crust pie; a Christmas Eve tradition.

dishes.name: Pâté chinois
dishes.veganApproach: Lentils and textured vegetable protein replace the beef, under creamed corn and a mash made with plant milk and margarine.
dishes.technique: Layers of seasoned ground beef, creamed corn and mashed potato ('steak, blé d'Inde, patates') are baked until the top is golden.

sources.title: Pâté chinois aux lentilles et PVT - Graceful Nutrition
Pâté chinois aux lentilles - Fondation Olo
